sections.heading: am / is / are'ın geçmişi
sections.body:
ŞimdiGeçmişÖrnek
I amI was «{w}oz»I was at home yesterday. → Dün evdeydim.
he / she / it iswasShe was tired. → Yorgundu.
you / we / they arewere «{w}öö»They were in London. → Londra'daydılar.

Türkçedeki “-di” eki (evdeydim, yorgundu) burada was / were olur.

sections.heading: Olumsuz ve soru
sections.body:
I wasn't «[{w}o]-zınt» at work. → İşte değildim.
We weren't «{w}öönt» late. → Geç kalmadık.
Was she at the party? — Yes, she was. / No, she wasn't.
Were you tired? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
Where were you? → Neredeydin?

there was / there were = vardı: There was a cat in the garden. There were many people.

sections.heading: Türklerin en sık hatası: doğmak
sections.body:
Türkçede “1990'da doğdum” deriz. İngilizcede “doğmak” edilgen bir yapıdır: was born «boon».

✔ I was born in 1990. → 1990'da doğdum.
✘ I born in 1990. ✘ I borned.
Where were you born? → Nerede doğdun?

Yıllar ikişer ikişer okunur: 1990 → nineteen ninety, 1985 → nineteen eighty-five, 2010 → twenty ten.
